question: Which of the following best describes special groups in community health nursing?

options.A: Populations with higher health risks and barriers to standard care
options.B: Healthy adults who require annual physical examinations only
options.C: Private corporate workers with high-income health insurance
options.D: Exclusively foreign nationals residing temporarily in urban centers

explanation: Special groups are vulnerable populations who experience higher health risks and face significant barriers to accessing standard healthcare services. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h1)

question: What is a primary responsibility of community health nurses regarding vulnerable cohorts in Nigeria?

options.A: Isolating them from the rest of the community permanently
options.B: Identifying them, conducting home visits, and designing targeted education
options.C: Requiring them to pay out-of-pocket for all specialized private care
options.D: Directing them exclusively to foreign international medical missions

explanation: Community health nurses play a pivotal role by identifying vulnerable cohorts, conducting home visits, and designing culturally sensitive health education programs. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h1)

question: Which level of government in Nigeria is primarily responsible for managing primary health care delivery at the grassroots?
explanation: Local government health authorities directly manage primary health care delivery at the grassroots level in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h2)

question: Why is it essential for nursing students to understand national health policy frameworks?

options.A: Policies dictate resource availability, service delivery, and the scope of practice
options.B: Nurses are required to write all federal laws regarding health budgets
options.C: Policies prevent nurses from ever engaging in community outreach
options.D: It replaces the need for clinical bedside nursing skills entirely

explanation: Policy frameworks are essential for nursing students to understand because they dictate resource availability, service delivery, and the scope of practice in health programs. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h2)

question: What is the primary function of the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare (FMoHSW) in Nigeria?

options.B: Formulating, coordinating, and implementing national health policies
options.C: Operating solely private tertiary hospitals for wealthy citizens
options.D: Handling foreign trade agreements unrelated to health

explanation: The FMoHSW is the apex body responsible for formulating, coordinating, and implementing health policies across Nigeria. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h3)

question: How does the Basic Health Care Provision Fund (BHCPF) assist special groups?

options.A: By lowering financial barriers for vulnerable groups seeking basic care
options.B: By funding luxurious private resort stays for retirees
options.C: By providing free international travel tickets for healthcare workers
options.D: By financing commercial agricultural businesses nationwide

explanation: The BHCPF helps lower financial barriers for pregnant women, children under five, and the elderly seeking basic healthcare services. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of the National Senior Citizens Centre (NSCC) in Nigeria?

options.A: To promote active aging, social inclusion, and accessible healthcare for older persons
options.B: To manage primary school admissions for young children
options.C: To regulate heavy industrial manufacturing plants
options.D: To construct national highways and bridges

explanation: The NSCC is established to cater specifically to older persons by promoting active aging, social inclusion, and accessible healthcare. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h4)

question: Which of the following is a key nursing intervention when caring for elderly clients in the community?

options.A: Restricting all physical activity and movement permanently
options.B: Assessing home environments and educating families on fall prevention
options.D: Encouraging complete social isolation from family members

explanation: Nurses act as vital links by assessing home environments, educating families on fall prevention, and connecting elderly clients with support packages. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h4)

question: Which initiative is an example of a government-backed program aimed at improving maternal and child health in Nigeria?
explanation: Saving One Million Lives (SOML) is a targeted government program implemented to improve maternal and child health outcomes in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h5)

question: What is a primary responsibility of community health nurses regarding maternal and child health interventions?

options.A: Enforcing financial penalties for mothers who miss routine checkups
options.B: Administering vaccines, educating on danger signs, and managing supplementation
options.C: Importing commercial pharmaceutical drugs from foreign manufacturers

explanation: Community health nurses are front-line executors who administer vaccines, educate mothers on danger signs, and manage micronutrient supplementation. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h5)

question: Which Nigerian agency is specifically responsible for safeguarding the rights of Persons with Disabilities (PWDs)?

options.A: National Commission for Persons with Disabilities (NCPWD)
options.B: National Primary Health Care Development Agency
options.D: Federal Ministry of Works and Housing

explanation: The NCPWD was established to safeguard the rights of PWDs and promote their full integration into society under national law. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h6)

question: What approach should community health nurses adopt when providing care for Persons with Disabilities?

options.A: A strictly punitive and custodial quarantine approach
options.B: A human-rights-based, inclusive, and empathetic approach
options.C: Ignoring physical accessibility needs during facility visits
options.D: Delegating all care exclusively to traditional healers

explanation: Caring for PWDs involves adopting a human-rights-based approach, eliminating biases, offering inclusive services, and showing empathy. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h6)

question: Which government ministries typically operate rehabilitation homes and counseling units for vulnerable populations in Nigeria?

options.B: Ministries of Women Affairs and Social Development

question: What is an essential component of care provided by community health nurses to victims of trauma or abuse?

options.A: Trauma-informed care, confidentiality, and prompt referral services
options.B: Publicly disclosing patient case details in the local market
options.C: Refusing medical treatment until legal investigations conclude

explanation: Nurses must provide immediate medical triage, trauma-informed care, confidentiality, and referral services for victims of abuse and trauma. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h7)

question: Why is inter-agency collaboration essential when caring for special groups in community health?

options.B: It addresses multifaceted social determinants and prevents service duplication

options.D: It focuses exclusively on administrative paperwork rather than patient care

question: What is a key nursing implication when participating in multidisciplinary teams for vulnerable populations?

options.A: Working in total isolation from other healthcare professionals
options.B: Developing strong communication skills and advocating for teamwork
options.C: Ignoring referral pathways and government support structures
options.D: Restricting patient care strictly to pharmaceutical administration

explanation: Nursing implications include developing strong communication skills, advocating for interprofessional teamwork, and utilizing seamless referral pathways. [learn more](GNS225_U5_T26#GNS225_U5_T26_h8)
